# A webhook handler

Read the raw body, verify the signature with `verifyWebhook` and the endpoint's `whsec_` secret, then act on `event.type`. Answer `2xx` quickly and do the work after.

## Next.js route handler

The same shape works in any Node.js server: raw body in, verified event out.

```ts file=verify-webhook.ts
import { verifyWebhook } from "@opem/node";

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const event = verifyWebhook({
    body: await request.text(),
    headers: request.headers,
    secret: process.env.OPEM_WEBHOOK_SECRET!, // whsec_…
  });
  if (event.type === "request.created") {
    console.log(event.data.request.reference);
  }
  return new Response(null, { status: 204 });
}
```
